name: They Don't Know Party Wojak
visual_description: MS Paint sketch of Wojak in a party hat standing alone in the corner watching couples dance.
usage_context: Used to express feelings of social alienation, niche personal flexes, or obscure knowledge nobody at a party cares about.

example.thought_text: They don't know I have 50k karma on Reddit

text_areas.description: Internal thought starting with 'They don't know...'
